mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 0.5% month-over-month signals inflationary pressures that typically lead to tighter monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% MoM and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) over three consecutive months signals a weakening labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.3pp over 3 months and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in real final sales (RSAFS) signals a contraction in consumer demand, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS decreases > 1% MoM and 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a strengthening supply side of the economy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2% and CPIAUCSL is above 3%, the combination signals a potential overheating economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 2% and CPIAUCSL > 3% and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tightening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases > 200k and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals a strengthening demand for housing, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases > 5% YoY and 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) signals a contraction in economic activity, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 decreases > 0.5% QoQ and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
